name: isaac_home_dev
_note: Development only (9 Nov 2026): validates composed Isaac homes, measures per-class Qwen3-VL recognisability and records a perception-capture dataset (no Qwen during capture). Not an evaluation. Perception development data comes ONLY from the l_shape kitchen and these composed homes (generator seeds 100-103). g_shape was viewed once for a recognisability check in session 2 of the cloud work; g_shape, peninsula and u_shape (and l_island, unloadable) are held-out candidates and are not captured or measured any further. Homes use the generator's development seeds 100-103 (the held-out seeds of the MuJoCo evaluation are 6000+). Home 101 D refrigerator was REFUSED by the composer (the native refrigerator footprint 0.67 x 1.23 m collides with a wall) and is replaced by 101 D sofa, chosen before any perception result. Targets come from the Isaac target set (refrigerator, bed, toilet, stove, washing_machine, workbench, sofa). Excluded classes (experiments/configs/isaac_assets.json 'excluded', version 1) are omitted and logged per home; assets that do not fit the generator footprint under the scale rule are placed natively or the home is refused (reported). Rule 3 class: environment simplification.

unloadable.l_island: segfault in PhysX between robot_contract_checked and world_reset after the refrigerator remap and the non-finite-collider repair; cause unknown (a hypothesis, not a finding: some prim PhysX cannot parse)
